description: Audit when a Robinhood stock token's supply was created or destroyed: every mint, burn, issue, redeem and transfer, newest first. Pass a ticker (NVDA) or a contract address on Robinhood Chain (4663); page through with the opaque cursor (keyset on block and log index). On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. Costs $0.005 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Arbitrum One).

cursor.description: The previous page's data.next_cursor; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 20). Not refused when outside: above 100 is cut to 100, below 1 becomes 1, as on the HTTP routes.

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).

name: token_events
title: Token issuance events
